summary: Build champion castles with Mobilityware’s one of a kind solitaire card game!
description:
Meet your new addiction! 
Break out of your boredom cell and cash in on the fun with Castle Solitaire card games!

Castle Solitaire is a fun and free Solitaire card game from MobilityWare, the maker of all your favorite solitaire card games. In this fast and easy to learn game, you can clash with kings, crush your enemies, build your castles, and fly your banner high!

== How to Play ==
To become a Castle Solitaire champion, fill the four castles from Ace to King. Tap to arrange cards of the same suit in descending order below the castles. If you get stuck, smash the stockpile to reveal more cards to use. Castle Solitaire is similar to Vanishing Cross or King’s Corner, but with it’s own special twist.

== Features ==
♠ Crush through challenging levels and earn new titles from Serf up to Town Crier and beyond!
♠ Customize your experience with different backgrounds and cards. You can even use one of your own photos as the background!
♠ Become a Solitaire winner and celebrate with exciting winning animations!
♠ Play offline on your own free time
♠ Cash in on your skills and collect badge rewards during weekly special events

== More Fun Card Games from MobilityWare ==
♣ Solitaire, also known as Klondike or Patience
♣ Spider Solitaire
♣ Freecell
♣ Pyramid Solitaire
♣ Crown Solitaire
♣ Tripeaks Solitaire
♣ Spider Go Solitaire
♣ Monopoly Solitaire

Relax and free your mind with this one of a kind free solitaire card game. Castle Solitaire introduces a clash of strategy and leisure. Smash through competitor stats, crush your high score, build your castles, and conquer with flair!

It's an addiction you won't want to break.
